intro: Front-end to back-end development. I started as a developer in 2009 and have been freelancing since June 2018.
aboutData: Hi, I'm a software engineer working broadly across front-end to back-end development. I focus on building services that are easy to use and easy to maintain.
I'm confident in my communication and adaptability, and can quickly settle into a team. I can work in Japanese at a business level.

I solve technical challenges with broad experience and adaptability, and approach my work with responsibility and persistence. I have release experience on both on-premise and AWS environments, and can communicate in English at an intermediate level.
Beyond professional development, I also have full-stack development experience using Python, React, Node, and Java in personal projects.
footerData: This site is built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with content loaded from JSON files, and is hosted on GitHub Pages.
